summary: End-to-end testing of GOLD-e multi-tenant SaaS. 35/35 backend pytest tests passed covering auth, tenant isolation, phone privacy, leads CRUD/AI-score/rescore/CSV import + dedup, pipeline stage moves, inbox (reply/suggest/summarize), templates + AI generate, campaigns (audience stats), automations, quotations (AI draft + creation + lead-stage sync), team RBAC (agent 403), API vault (encrypted + masked, agent 403), AI marketing studio, AI command center, dashboard KPIs. Full Playwright UI walk-through of all 12 pages passed with masked phones, seeded content visible, AI suggest/summarize/marketing/command working, and no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~950 lines all-in-one; consider splitting into routers/services (auth, leads, campaigns, ai) for maintainability, but not blocking.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for JWT-Bearer flow; acceptable.
llm_text() uses model 'gpt-5.4' hard-coded — heuristic fallbacks cover failure cases so endpoints never hard-fail (verified in tests).
audit() writes into db.audit on every action — no index defined; consider workspace_id index for scale.
phone_hash uses VAULT_KEY as HMAC secret via concatenation (should use hmac.new for correctness) — low priority since it is server-side dedup only.
team DELETE uses filter role != 'owner' silently (no error if trying to delete owner) — currently protected but returns ok:true even on no-op.
test_credentials: demo@gold-e.ai / demo1234 (owner), priya@gold-e.ai / agent1234 (agent) — both work as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Some TEST_* leads/templates/campaigns/vault entries created inside demo workspace during pytest and playwright runs; can be cleaned by matching TEST prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers all major flows including tenant isolation and phone-privacy assertions. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v
